sentences.text: Parasutterella excrementihominis, the species for which the genus was proposed, is a strictly anaerobic, non-spore-forming, Gram-negative coccobacillus isolated from human faeces.
The genus has been defined as a core component of the human and mouse gut microbiota, and mouse, rat and human isolates were asaccharolytic producers of succinate.
A study of a mouse isolate reported changes in bile acid derivatives, supporting a possible role for Parasutterella in bile acid maintenance and cholesterol metabolism.
In a European cohort with validation in a Canadian cohort, Parasutterella was reported to be positively associated with BMI, type 2 diabetes and dietary carbohydrate intake.
